newsitem.title: USA: American Mobile Satellite names CFO.
newsitem.headline: American Mobile Satellite names CFO.

text.p: American Mobile Satellite Corp said it named Stephen Peck chief financial officer.
The company was not immediately available to provide information on whom, if anyone, Peck replaced.

Peck was previously executive vice president and chief financial officer at Potomac, Md.-based Phillips Publishing International, a provider of information to specialized consumer and business marketplaces, including the satellite and telecommunications industries.
A company spokeswoman later said Peck replaced Patrick FitzPatrick, who resigned in February to take a job with another company.
